about_the_game:
Criminal Inn Simulator

Welcome to the Criminal Inn Simulator — where every room hides a secret.

Run a rundown roadside motel somewhere in the middle of nowhere. Greet guests, clean rooms, upgrade furniture... but don’t get too comfortable. Beneath the daily grind lies a dark underworld: murders in guest rooms, shady visitors, police investigations, and even shootouts.

Gameplay Features:

  • Motel Management:
    Check in clients, keep rooms clean, fulfill their needs (Wi-Fi, TV, breakfast), and build your reputation.

  • Cleaning with surprises:
    Picking up trash and bottles is one thing. Sometimes... you’ll have to take care of a body.

  • Criminal Storylines:
    Discover strange clues, deal with suspicious deaths, and decide whether to investigate or cover up the mess.

  • Interact with the Police:
    Will you report the evidence or lie to protect your business? Your reputation is on the line.

  • Economy and Upgrades:
    Earn money, furnish rooms, buy appliances, and turn your dump into a deluxe operation.

  • Open-Ended Gameplay:
    Play it straight or dive into crime. The choice is yours.

A daily grind full of dark surprises

Your mornings start with breakfast trays, laundry, and check-ins. But by nightfall... there might be a corpse in Room 101.

content_descriptors.notes: Some scenes feature partially nude bodies (topless), shown from the back. These scenes are presented for artistic purposes only and do not include sexual interaction or explicit acts.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 3.0 GHz or Ryzen 3xxx
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 960 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (recent generation)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1070 or better 6GB VRAM

  • Storage: 15 GB available space
